# Third-party assets in static/vendor

| File | Project | License |
|---|---|---|
| pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs | pdf.js 4.8.69 (Mozilla) | Apache-2.0 (header inline) |
| marked.min.js | marked | MIT (header inline) |
| motion.min.js | Motion (motion.dev) | MIT |
| spectral-400.woff2, spectral-600.woff2 | Spectral (Production Type, Google Fonts) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

These files are vendored unmodified so the app works offline. Each project's license text is available at its upstream repository.
